# Software Engineer, Tooling & Automation

Copenhagen, Denmark· Entry (0–1 years)· Full Time· kr539,400 - kr809,200 per year· 21 days ago

Software Engineer, Tooling & Automation

## The opportunity

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test to join the Automation and Tooling Team. This is a great opportunity for graduates or early-career engineers looking to grow in a highly technical environment. Our team consists of Software Development Engineers in Test spread across two locations in Europe, working collaboratively across sites and time zones.

You will join a team responsible for the test infrastructure underpinning Unity's continuous integration. The team builds and maintains CI pipelines across a wide range of platforms — desktop, mobile, consoles, XR and embedded systems — ensuring that Unity's engine and editor are thoroughly tested before every release. You will work alongside platform specialists and collaborate with development teams across Unity to keep CI pipelines healthy, investigate test failures, and improve test coverage and stability.

Being part of the team, you will ensure the highest possible quality and productivity for feature development by creating and maintaining CI pipelines, and help developers efficiently use them. You will also leverage modern AI tools to enhance productivity and explore new approaches to test automation and analysis.

## What you'll be doing

- Creating and maintaining CI pipelines for Unity across supported platforms
- Building and improving tools and frameworks for optimizing platform and test coverage
- Troubleshooting complex, failing CI scenarios across code and infrastructure
- Working cross-team and cross-site to coordinate test infrastructure changes with development teams, platform teams, and other stakeholders
- Advocating good engineering practices in the team and ensuring tooling surrounding quality is just as important as the product itself
- Utilizing AI tools as Claude to boost productivity in analysis, automation, and problem-solving

## What we're looking for

- Experience with or knowledge of Unity and its usage
- Programming experience in C#, with secondary experience in Python
- Experience with CI/CD systems, for example Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar
- Experience with or knowledge of AI tools usage, such as Claude, for development productivity
- An analytical mindset with the ability to debug issues across code and infrastructure layers
- A team player who thrives in a collaborative, cross-site environment
- 0–3 years of professional working experience

## You might also have

- Knowledge of specific platforms supported by Unity
- Knowledge of Unity test frameworks and testing methodologies
- Familiarity with scripting in Bash or PowerShell
- Experience with development supporting tools such as Git, code review workflows, and project management tools as Jira
- Interest in test infrastructure, test stability analysis, or code coverage tooling

Life at Unity

Unity [NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit www.unity.com.
